findings.quote_bytes: survivors of D2 are ranked by (i) ancestry-distance tier (family's min measured |rho| descending — construction property of the measurement, applied mechanically), then (ii) P0 fired-population size descending, then (iii) lexicographic config ID; the top <= 3 become scored candidates.
findings.why_wrong: Three defects in the cycle's core artifact. (a) AMBIGUOUS STATISTIC: 'family's min measured |rho|' does not say whether the minimum runs over the family's configurations, over the shadow set, or over config-times-shadow pairs, and the pooling operator behind each rho is itself unpinned (see F-2); the ranking is therefore not reproducible from the plan bytes. (b) INVERTED DIRECTION: labeling 'min |rho| DESCENDING' as ancestry-distance means the scored budget is spent first on the surviving family with the HIGHEST correlation to lethal shadow states — the family grazing the 0.30 veto boundary, i.e. the LEAST ancestry-distinct survivor; no rationale for this direction is given, and the label contradicts itself (higher rho-to-shadow = smaller distance from dead ancestry). (c) BREADTH COLLAPSE + NO BOOKS-DISTINCT LAW: the family key dominates the lexicographic tuple, so unless the top-tier family has fewer than three surviving configurations, ALL <=3 scored cells go to configurations of a single family, contradicting section 1 ('This is a SEARCH cycle ... breadth is the point'); and the plan carries no P-20 books-distinct/self-subsumption rule anywhere, while every recent predecessor does (PLAN_stocks_ng6.md: 'preregistered self-subsumption |rho| <= 0.98 vs anchor (P-20 books-distinct), else SELF-SUBSUMED'; PLAN_forex_ng5.md: 'books_distinct is unmeasurable (P-20 fail-closed None)'; CRYPTO-V15 enforced 'control self-subsumption rho 0.9929' pre-score). As written, the three scored books may be mutually self-subsumed near-duplicates (e.g. EVENT-UNWIND K=21/H=5, K=21/H=10, K=63/H=5) that DSR N=grid-size and the terminal result language would count as independent search breadth. This changes the conclusion: which 3 of 43 configurations consume the entire irreversibly-spent scored budget, and what 'SURVIVORS' subsequently means.
findings.required_remediation: Pin in the plan text or as required fail-closed D1-manifest fields: (i) the exact tier-(i) statistic and the rho pooling operator it consumes; (ii) the tier direction with stated rationale; (iii) a per-family cap on scored candidates or a family-stratified selection order; (iv) a P-20 pairwise books-distinct rule among the selected scored candidates (NG6 0.98 class, fail-closed NOT_ADJUDICABLE when unmeasurable).
evidence_paths: research/wayfinder/FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl (CRYPTO-V15 A6-V15-F1-TAKER-SAT row: control self-subsumption rho 0.9929)

findings.quote_bytes: R0  pre-score ancestry veto   pooled |rho| > 0.30 (owner-relaxed, §3) vs ANY R0 shadow on the frozen decision grid -> configuration dies pre-score; ... it re-admits the STOCKS-NG6 measured class (0.201–0.260, public committed history) and does NOT re-admit the FOREX-NG5 momentum kill class (0.353).
findings.why_wrong: The pre-score mechanism that decides which configurations may ever be scored is indeterminate from the plan bytes. (a) SELF-SHADOW CONVENTION UNPINNED: the R0 inventory contains states that ARE the own conditioning class of three of the six candidate families — 'dollar-volume-shock state' (family 5 DVOL-SHOCK), 'realized-vol LEVEL + semivariance share states ... event-conditional vol-tercile' (family 6 VOL-REGIME), '52-week-high proximity generic' (family 3, acknowledged 'candidate AND a shadow for other families — both roles hashed'). Whether a configuration is rho-tested against its OWN family's shadow decides family survival (own-state rho is trivially ~1, killing 18 of 43 configurations across 3 families under the plain 'vs ANY R0 shadow' reading) versus testing only against OTHER families' shadows (where survival is an open empirical question). The only lineage precedent, NG6's 'self-subsumption 0.7996 moot', was anchor-vs-neighbour, not config-vs-own-shadow, so lineage does not answer it; in-cycle reinterpretation in either direction changes which configurations get scored. (b) 'POOLED' IS UNDEFINED: max, mean, or Fisher-combination across shadows give different verdicts at the 0.30 boundary; NG6's plan left the same word, but NG6's D2 contract carried the definition in its frozen run artifacts and SEARCH-V1 names no such carrier. (c) SELECTIVE RECITAL: section 2 recites NG6's kill set as 'measured event-conditional rho 0.260 / 0.219 / 0.201', omitting the fourth BINDING form dvol_shock at -0.320 recorded in the STOCKS-NG6 terminal registry row; consequently section 3's boundedness claim 're-admits the STOCKS-NG6 measured class (0.201–0.260)' misstates the re-admitted set — the 0.30 floor also does NOT re-admit NG6's own measured 0.320 dollar-volume class, while family 5 (DVOL-SHOCK) is placed in the grid with no disclosure of its expected dead-on-arrival status. Fail-closed in the strict direction, but the recital is what the owner grant's boundedness argument rests on and it is incomplete.
findings.required_remediation: Pin in plan text: (i) whether own-family shadows are included in each configuration's R0 test, or a preregistered P-20-class self-subsumption handling; (ii) the pooling operator and its fail-closed behavior at boundary values; (iii) corrected section 2/3 recitals including the -0.320 class; (iv) explicit disclosure of which families are expected to die at R0 under the pinned convention, so the six-family breadth premise is honest.
evidence_paths: plans/PLAN_stocks_ng6.md (lines 244-257 R0 inventory; line 283 'self-subsumption 0.7996 moot' is in the registry row)

findings.quote_bytes: PBO fail-closed < 8 configurations. ... NO return, expectancy, PF, Sharpe or any performance statistic may be computed for ANY configuration before the S freeze ... budget            3 scored cells max
findings.why_wrong: The PBO gate is unsatisfiable as written for this cycle's own outcome space, making the prewritten terminal outcome STOCKS_SEARCH_V1_SURVIVORS_UNDER_RELAXED_BATTERY unreachable — the plan contradicts itself at exactly the outcome a search cycle exists to reach. Program precedent fixes the meaning of the phrase: CBO/CSCV PBO requires a performance matrix over >=8 configurations (CRYPTO-V14: 'PBO NOT_RUN fail-closed (CSCV minimum 8 configurations unmet at the 6-cell cap)'; FOREX-FREE-V8: 'PBO NOT_RUN fail-closed (3<8 CSCV)'). In SEARCH-V1: (a) computing grid-wide (43-configuration) performance is forbidden before S by section 5 and unbudgeted after S (3 cells), so the gate can never be computed over the grid; (b) with <=3 scored configurations PBO is NOT_RUN-fail-closed under the program's own frozen alternative (V17 contract / FOREX-NG1 precedent d0992d17, explicitly cited by RATES-NG1, COMMODITIES-NG1 and VOL-NG1), which SEARCH-V1 does not cite; and (c) under the plan's own disposition rule ('a control that is unpopulated or has an invalid null is NOT_ADJUDICABLE, never silently skipped') plus the workspace invariant that NOT_RUN is never inferred PASS, a fail-closed NOT_RUN PBO leaves Stage-A unpassable — no survivor can ever be declared under this plan as written.
findings.required_remediation: Prewrite the PBO disposition for the <=3-cell regime in the plan: cite the frozen V17/FOREX-NG1 d0992d17 alternative explicitly and state whether a survivor with PBO NOT_RUN is bookable (with the NOT_RUN printed on the result) or NOT_ADJUDICABLE; or redefine the PBO input set so the gate is computable within the 3-cell budget and the section 5 freeze rule. Any performance computed for PBO must itself be charged to the trial-accounting rules the plan adopts.
evidence_paths: research/wayfinder/FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl (CRYPTO-V14 row 'PBO NOT_RUN fail-closed (CSCV minimum 8 configurations unmet at the 6-cell cap)'; FOREX-FREE-V8 row 'PBO NOT_RUN fail-closed (3<8 CSCV)')
.runtime/orchestrator_v3/tasks.json (VOL-NG1 I-IMPLEMENTATION objective: 'PBO fail-closed when cells < 8 — ... the frozen alternative rule from the FOREX-NG1 precedent applies')

The reserved second branch requires an 'owner plan naming a changed killer'; here the killer-naming at axis/magnitude granularity is done by THIS plan (R0 0.30, DSR alpha 0.10, N=grid <=120, breadth <=120 are implementer instantiations of the grant), so section 2's sentence overstates the quoted bytes. This is therefore a characterization defect, not an illegality — but the overstatement must not travel into the registration record.

findings.quote_bytes: C-CAL-HIST          deterministic calendar book matched to the fired-date distribution; must NOT out-earn the candidate (R6 extends to it) ... R4  component placebo         family component-only book reproduces >= 0.5x same-sign -> REJECT ... warmup attrition CENSUSED
findings.why_wrong: Three specifications are weaker than the NG6 lineage this cycle claims to re-inherit, and the D1 manifest — which must carry the freeze burden ('this cycle's A2-equivalent dossier IS the manifest') — is not required by the plan to contain them. (a) C-CAL-HIST: NG6 pins 'the same day-of-week/month-position histogram as the observed events; deterministic rule declared ex ante BEFORE any measurement'; SEARCH-V1 keeps only 'matched to the fired-date distribution' — which moments, which buckets, and what minimum population per bucket are open, leaving the R6 calendar control researcher degrees of freedom (the packet's 'weekday-share-type floors' concern is exactly this). (b) R4's 'family component-only book' is declared nowhere: section 6 declares only per-family C-COMPLEMENT (NG6 carried distinct books for its R3 and R5); if R4's book is the complement, R3 and R4 are redundant; if it is not, the book is undefined and R4 can never be adjudicated. (c) Warmup: NG6's A4-corrected rule (252 served sessions; first eligible event no earlier than the 253rd) is not re-inherited — the sub-grids use lookbacks up to 252 (K=252, 252-session trailing gap distribution, 252-session high) plus a trailing-60-session bookability window whose interaction needs a pinned warmup length. Also folded here: the EVENT-UNWIND family description ('failed K-session-low breakdown w/ same-session reclaim') drops NG6's pinned construction components (RANGE >= 0.5 upper-half close, PARTICIPATION >= 1.5x dvol60, close-above-broken-level reclaim definition) without saying whether they are in or out of the grid-extended class.
findings.required_remediation: Enumerate required fail-closed D1-manifest fields in the plan: per-configuration full construction definitions (reclaim test, range/participation filter membership for EVENT-UNWIND), the C-CAL-HIST matching rule with per-bucket floors, the R4 book definition per family, and the warmup rule.
